column1: # TITLE: Comparison of microRNA Profiling Platforms (BeadChip)
# SUMMARY: Global miRNA expression profiling of human malignancies is gaining popularity in both basic and clinically driven research. But to date
column2: the majority of such analyses have used microarrays and quantitative real-time PCR. With the introduction of digital count technologies
column3: such as next-generation sequencing (NGS) and the NanoString nCounter System
column5: many more options. To make effective use of these different platforms
column6: the strengths and pitfalls of several miRNA profiling technologies were assessed
column8: NGS technologies and the NanoString nCounter System. These results were compared to gold-standard quantitative real-time PCR.
